title: Choose Clickity’s visual world
question: Choose the world that should make Clickity feel modern, fast, and at home beside a game.

options.label: Frame Trace
options.lineage: game replay timelines and frame debuggers
options.thesis: Every click becomes a visible timing event on a precise frame trace, so setup and runtime state read in one glance.
options.viewport: A wide timing rail commands the upper third, four compact time fields sit directly on its ticks, and a coral start control anchors the lower edge beside a live click trace.
options.risk: It can feel like a developer tool if the time ruler overwhelms the plain-language labels.

options.label: Page 006
options.thesis: Clickity becomes a direct-access control page where timing, target, and run state occupy a strict broadcast grid.
options.viewport: A three-digit page header leads into double-height interval figures, compact mode rows, and a bottom command strip with START and STOP states.
options.risk: Its gaming recognition and numeric clarity are strong, but it may read as deliberately retro rather than distinctly modern.
options.case: Audience identification: strong for retro-aware players. Product clarity: strong for numbers and state, weaker for comfortable form entry.

options.label: Lock Frame
options.thesis: The target and click interval sit inside a focus frame that visibly locks when a run begins.
options.viewport: A large central focus bracket holds the interval, settings occupy the safe-area corners, and an amber W-to-T rail becomes the run-progress control.
options.risk: The HUD feels native to games, but the camera metaphor can make ordinary click settings less immediately obvious.
options.case: Audience identification: strongest of the challengers. Product clarity: moderate because the framing metaphor competes with familiar controls.

options.label: Axis Console
options.thesis: One monumental interval readout changes live while compact control axes tune the click behavior below it.
options.viewport: The current interval fills half the window as expressive numerals, with timing axes below and a single cobalt run control completing the composition.
options.risk: Its product clarity is excellent, but its foundry-like character has the weakest connection to gaming culture.
options.case: Audience identification: low. Product clarity: highest challenger score through scale, live values, and direct manipulation.

canonCard.label: Modern Utility Panel
canonCard.thesis: A familiar card-based settings panel makes every control effortless to find and the primary action unmistakable.
canonCard.viewport: A compact header and status pill lead into clean timing, click, and target cards, ending with a full-width blue start button.
canonCard.risk: It would be polished and easy to use, but could remain visually interchangeable with many unrelated desktop utilities.
